title: Runpod AnimateDiff (Text-to-Video · Motion LoRAs)
description: Serverless GPU text-to-video using AnimateDiff (SD1.5 motion modules + SDXL-beta adapter). Send a text prompt, receive a short clip as mp4 (default), animated GIF, or a list of base64 PNG frames. Stack optional camera-motion LoRAs (zoom-in/out, pan-left/right, tilt-up/down, rolling cw/ccw) on top of any SD1.5 base. Supports AnimateLCM for fast 4-8 step generation. Note: AnimateDiff motion modules ship under the guoyww research license; the base diffusion checkpoints follow each model card's terms.

input.name: Default base diffusion model
input.description: HuggingFace repo id of the SD1.5 or SDXL backbone to preload on cold start. Options include emilianJR/epiCRealism (default), SG161222/Realistic_Vision_V5.1_noVAE, runwayml/stable-diffusion-v1-5, stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0.

input.name: Default motion adapter
input.description: HuggingFace repo id of the MotionAdapter weights paired with the backbone. Options: guoyww/animatediff-motion-adapter-v1-5-3 (default, SD1.5), guoyww/animatediff-motion-adapter-v1-5-2 (SD1.5), wangfuyun/AnimateLCM (LCM-distilled SD1.5), guoyww/animatediff-motion-adapter-sdxl-beta (SDXL).

input.name: HuggingFace cache root
input.description: Directory used by HuggingFace Hub to cache downloaded weights. Mount a persistent volume here to skip cold-start downloads across restarts.

input.name: Allow any HF model id
input.description: Set to '1' to disable curated base/adapter validation and accept any HuggingFace repo id per request. Off by default for safety.
